title: NextCraft - Just Smoother
description: Smoother Minecraft Take ur Vanilla minecraft to the next level
body:
🌿 NextCraft
Vanilla. Just better.

NextCraft is a lightweight Fabric modpack that enhances Minecraft without changing its core feeling.
No crazy mechanics, no overwhelming content — just a smoother, prettier, and more polished vanilla experience.

✨ What is NextCraft?

NextCraft focuses on visual improvements, performance, and quality-of-life features while staying true to vanilla gameplay.

You still play Minecraft — just better.

🎯 Features

🌱 Vanilla+ Experience
Everything feels familiar — no major gameplay changes
🎨 Improved Visuals
Better lighting, animations, particles, and overall atmosphere
⚡ High Performance
Optimized with performance mods like Sodium/C2ME/Entity Culling
🧰 Quality of Life
Small but impactful improvements (BetterF3, Better Mount HUD, Chat Animation, etc.)
🌍 Exploration Enhancements
Mods like Dungeons & Taverns add more structures to discover
🎮 Smooth Gameplay
Better controls, camera, and overall feel

📦 Included Mod Types

Performance (C2ME, EntityCulling, Clumps)
Visual Enhancements (Continuity, Entity Texture Features, Particle Improvements)
UI & QoL (BetterF3, Controlling, ChatAnimation)
World Enhancements (Dungeons & Taverns, Cherished Worlds)
Utility (Chunky, Delete Worlds To Trash, Inventory tweaks)

💡 Who is this for?

Players who want vanilla Minecraft, but polished
People with low to mid-end PCs who want better performance
Anyone who prefers simple, clean modpacks

🚀 Why NextCraft?

Because sometimes you don’t need more content —
you just want Minecraft to feel right.

📌 Notes
Fabric-based modpack
Works best with shaders (optional)
Regular updates & improvements planned
